systems.tiers: A handbook given to pregnant women and newborns; piloted in selected districts 2019-2021, adopted as national standard in 2022, ready for nationwide rollout; the NCRA Director General announced on 5 March 2026 that it will be recognised as a valid document for birth registration

note: A paper health handbook to be accepted as a supporting document for birth registration; no digital registration system is named or described.
